title: Updates
intro: Which releases the fleet follows, and whether each part updates itself, offers an update or waits for a pinned version. See docs/updates.md.

items.text: This desktop updates itself (paired, its hub decides; standalone, these rows do), only to a release the release key signed. The Docker hub updates itself through fleet-updater (opt-in). nightly: the hub on each green main push, the desktop once a day.
The desktop row is also this desktop's own: notify offers a restart to update, automatic installs at the next launch, manual installs only a pin. See docs/updates.md.
